rules_evaluated.fix_hint: Optional: tail the fence with 'No preamble -- do the steps, then report the SHA.' Low priority given the mild harm.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Minimal hand-off + Claude self-augments for send-off prompts.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Harm: this rule names a four-section shape for long-running send-offs -- (1) task+paths, (2) rules/fallback/walk-away framing, (3) self-augment invitation ('ask for or write anything else you want for this run'), (4) report-back. The take-task-end-to-end prompt (the file's central send-off) has (1), (2), and (4) but is missing (3) entirely: nothing invites Claude to ask for or write its own scaffolding before starting a 90+ minute unattended run. The rule's own bet -- 'Claude knows what scaffolding it needs better than student does' -- is exactly the leverage this send-off would gain most from, since the student is about to walk away and cannot supply anything mid-run.
rules_evaluated.fix_hint: Add one clause before 'Go.': 'Before you start, ask for or write anything else you want for this run.'
